ragChunks.docTitle: SEBI & Indian Capital Gains Tax FY26 Rules
ragChunks.content: Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG) on listed Indian equities and equity-oriented mutual funds/ETFs held for less than 365 days (12 months) are taxed at a flat 20% under Section 111A of the Income Tax Act (revised upward from 15% in Union Budget FY25-26). STT must be paid on NSE/BSE delivery trades.

ragChunks.docTitle: SEBI & Indian Capital Gains Tax FY26 Rules
ragChunks.content: Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) on listed NSE equities and equity ETFs held for 365 days or more are taxed at 12.5% without indexation, with an annual tax-free exemption limit of ₹1,25,000 per financial year. Investors can harvest up to ₹1,25,000 of LTCG before March 31 and immediately re-buy to step up their acquisition cost basis.

ragChunks.docTitle: SEBI & Indian Capital Gains Tax FY26 Rules
ragChunks.content: Short-Term Capital Losses (STCL) can be set off against both STCG (20%) and LTCG (12.5%). Long-Term Capital Losses (LTCL) can only be set off against LTCG. Unabsorbed capital losses can be carried forward for up to 8 assessment years provided the Income Tax Return is filed before the due date.

ragChunks.docTitle: SEBI & Indian Capital Gains Tax FY26 Rules
ragChunks.content: SEBI Circular on unregistered financial influencers prohibits regulated entities from associating with unregistered individuals who make guaranteed return claims, multi-bagger promises, or stock tips on social media reels. Investors should verify PE, debt-to-equity, promoter pledge, and 1-year realized volatility before acting on social media tips.

ragChunks.docTitle: NSE Top Nifty 50 Risk & Sector Guide
ragChunks.content: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS.NS) and Infosys (INFY.NS) are net-cash, high-ROE Indian IT bellwethers with strong dividend yields and USD revenue sensitivity. Key risk factors include US BFSI discretionary tech spend slowdowns and INR/USD currency volatility. Historical annualized volatility typically ranges between 18% and 23%.

ragChunks.docTitle: NSE Top Nifty 50 Risk & Sector Guide
ragChunks.content: HDFC Bank (HDFCBANK.NS) and ICICI Bank (ICICIBANK.NS) anchor Nifty 50 financial weight (~22%). Net Interest Margin (NIM) compression during RBI repo rate cut cycles and unsecured retail credit costs are primary drivers. Post-merger LDR normalization remains a closely tracked metric for HDFCBANK.NS.

ragChunks.docTitle: NSE Top Nifty 50 Risk & Sector Guide
ragChunks.pageOrSection: Page 3 · Energy, Auto & Pharma (RELIANCE, TATAMOTORS, SUNPHARMA)
ragChunks.content: Reliance Industries (RELIANCE.NS) blends O2C cash flows with Jio Digital and Reliance Retail growth. Tata Motors (TATAMOTORS.NS) carries higher beta (~30% annualized volatility) driven by JLR cyclicality and domestic EV capex. Sun Pharma (SUNPHARMA.NS) offers defensive US specialty pharma margins with lower correlation to domestic credit cycles.

India VIX (^INDIAVIX) measures 30-day expected Nifty 50 volatility. Readings below 15 signal calm bull markets where momentum strategies outperform. Readings above 18–20 signal heightened tail-risk regimes where rotating 50%–70% of equity capital into GOLDBEES.NS or LIQUIDBEES.NS sharply compresses maximum drawdown and improves Calmar ratio.

LIQUIDBEES.NS tracks overnight TREPS/call money rates anchored near India 91-day T-Bill yield (~6.7% p.a.) with near-zero price drawdown. For salaried UPI cashflow management, maintaining an emergency buffer equal to Monthly Spend Mean + 1.5 * Monthly Spend StdDev prevents forced equity liquidation during market crashes.

Holding 3 or more large-cap or flexi-cap Indian mutual funds often creates 55%–75% portfolio overlap around top Nifty 50 stocks while paying active expense ratios of 0.6%–1.0%. Combining one low-cost Nifty 50 Index fund (UTI Nifty 50) with one non-overlapping Mid/Small Cap or Flexi-Cap fund maximizes net alpha.
